title: rotula pohlii
intro: Rotula pohlii, commonly known as the "tiger's balm" or "madagascar rote," is a plant species native to Madagascar and belongs to the Bignoniaceae family. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments. The health benefits of Rotula pohlii include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful for treating wounds, fever, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Rotula pohlii include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties.
